title: Redesign - design_llm_8b 4-bit (the batch model)
cost_line: Runs on the GPU box (no music, still, video or matte generation)
note: The design step again over a finished generation's archive: the open model sees the footage contact sheets and the music, designs the type and the compose look; the code mends invalid fields one by one (design_salvage.py); only the type and the composite are rendered again. Arm: design_llm_8b-4bit.

fields.label: Source video
fields.hint: The generation's final mp4: its audio is the song.

fields.label: Request (JSON)
fields.hint: words / scene / music / look / shots / length / seed of the generation; empty = rebuilt from the piece.
